name: unsold-estimate-follow-up-audit
description: Triage delivered estimates, distinguish normal pending decisions from suitable unresolved opportunities and diagnose why quotes fail to become completed jobs.

interface.longDescription: Triage delivered estimates, distinguish normal pending decisions from suitable unresolved opportunities and diagnose why quotes fail to become completed jobs. For home service owners and teams. Delivers editable company-branded Markdown plus styled HTML, evidence labels and an internally usable implementation blueprint. Matches verified website branding or owner-selected trade palettes. Qualitative findings are valid when data is missing. Conditional financial opportunity is not guaranteed. Plans and drafts only; no live integrations, automatic outreach, calendar changes or monitoring. AI Growth Studio is the developer; optional implementation support is separate from the audit.
defaultPrompt: Audit our unsold estimates and build an appropriate follow-up process.
